name: show-full-ticket
description: User asks for everything about a ticket; agent should use `jira show` (single API call) instead of get+describe+comments.
prompt: Popiš mi všechno, co víš o ticketu KNW-31435 — status, summary, description i komentáře.
expected_behaviors: makes exactly one call to the jira wrapper
presents header, description as plain text, and comments section
does NOT dump raw JSON to the user
anti_patterns: calls `jira get`, then `jira describe`, then `jira comments` separately
uses raw curl to JIRA API
uses `jira --json` and parses ADF manually with jq
outputs ADF tree to the user
